FIELD.name: wfpdb_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Plate identification in the Wide-Field Plate Database

FIELD.name: filter
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Filter type used during the observation

FIELD.name: site_longitude
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: East longitude of the observing site, in decimal degrees

FIELD.name: site_latitude
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Latitude of the observing site, in decimal degrees

FIELD.name: ota_name
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the telescope optical tube assembly (OTA) that was used to expose the plate

FIELD.name: ota_diameter
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Diameter of the telescope optical tube assembly (OTA)

FIELD.name: ota_aperture
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Clear aperture of the telescope optical tube assembly (OTA)

FIELD.name: ota_foclen
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Focal length of the telescope optical tube assembly (OTA)

FIELD.name: ota_scale
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Plate scale of the telescope optical tube assembly (OTA)

FIELD.name: method_code
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: method_code follows the WFPDB coding: see Note in the description of table

FIELD.name: prism
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Information about the objective prism used

FIELD.name: sky_transparency
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Sky transparency (seeing conditions), scale 1-5 (German: Durchsicht, Klarheit)
